formal_statement: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (side : V → Bool) (F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V)) (π : List (PEqualNP.Search.CPLine V)), PEqualNP.Search.IsCPRefutation F π → ∃ ρ : List (Set (V → Bool)), PEqualNP.Search.IsTriDagFor side F ρ ∧ ρ.length ≤ π.length
plain_statement: For any CNF F, any split of its variables and any cutting planes refutation of F over the integers, the falsified sets of its lines form a triangle dag solving the search problem of F with at most as many nodes. Known result formalized: Sokolov (STOC 2017) and Hrubes-Pudlak (IPL 2017); reproved as Proposition 1.6 of ECCC TR25-057.
title: Cutting planes refutations give triangle dags of no more nodes, under any split
